CONTROL TEST (rn:box:selfhosted-account:selfhosted-project:artifact:98f73b06-261c-43dc-8a7c-cbd1fd15d432): clicking Design from the completely UNFILTERED list with an empty search box reproduces the identical result, proving the search feature did not break click-through - the underlying navigation behaviour is intact and unregressed.

issues: Contract check 6 fails as written: /teams/2/edit does not display the heading 'Edit Team "Design"'. Navigation and document.title are correct, but the on-page heading and the whole team edit form are missing.

Root cause is a one-field defect in the delivered mock harness: frontend/mocks/seed.ts emits the team permission as "right": 2, but the Vikunja frontend model reads "max_permission" (abstractModel.ts -> maxPermission). EditTeam.vue's userIsAdmin computed therefore evaluates false and hides the edit card (name/description fields, save and delete buttons). Renaming the seed field right -> max_permission should restore it. This is mock data only, not application code.

Because the edit card is hidden by the above, team editing and deletion UI could not be exercised at all in this environment, so 'do not change team creation, editing or deletion behaviour' could only be confirmed by code inspection (EditTeam.vue is untouched by the commit) rather than by clicking.

Minor deviation from spec, non-blocking: the search input is rendered with v-if="teams.length > 0", so an account with zero teams sees no search box at all. The task said to render the input above the team list without conditioning it on team count. It does not affect any of the six checks and is arguably better UX.

Environment note carried over from the dev half and confirmed: package.json declares engines.node >=24 while this container runs Node 22, so pnpm emits an Unsupported engine warning. Everything ran fine here, but strict CI would turn that warning into an error.
notes:
The search feature itself is correct and complete - checks 1 through 5 all passed exactly as written, seen in a real browser, with zero console errors across the whole session (0 errors, 0 warnings from 6 total messages). Scope was verified against the commit: only ListTeams.vue and en.json were modified in src/, plus three new additive mock files (mocks/apiMock.ts, mocks/seed.ts, vite.mock.config.ts). No store and no service file was touched, and en.json is the only language file changed - the two new strings sit under the existing team section as team.search.placeholder and team.search.noResults, both rendered through $t(). I also independently confirmed the no-new-API-call requirement with a fetch/XHR spy rather than taking it on trust.

I am marking verified:false solely because check 6 specifies a visible heading that does not render. I want to be precise about blame: the search feature did NOT cause it. My control test - clicking Design from the unfiltered list with an empty search box - reproduces the missing heading identically, so click-through behaviour is unregressed. The defect lives in the seeded mock data the dev half also delivered, and it is a single field name away from correct. A reviewer should treat this as 'fix the mock, then re-run check 6' rather than as a problem with the Teams search box.
